PHYS71 completed the all-angular/all-radial third Born coefficient, while a quantitative bound on the actual outgoing Coulomb Green operator and the higher exterior Born remainder remained open. This additive cycle closes that fixed exterior obligation.

- Proves the actual Dirichlet outgoing inverse bound ||R0 f/r|| <= C_R ||r f||, C_R=(10+sqrt(1423))/189 < 253/1000, retaining the nonzero Coulomb boundary flux.
- Controls the original noncentral screen on radial/angular L2, H1 and the inherited growing-C_j spaces. The actual L2 sandwich norm is q=553311/10^26=5.53311e-21; the R0 V bounds on H1 and H_C are 2q and 77q.
- Establishes operator-norm convergence at lambda=1 and the (21,20),m0 order>=4 tail <1.50654e-80 a0^-1. Reusing the unchanged corrected PHYS71 D3 center encloses (Z1-Z0)-exactD1-exactD2 within 7.271949342749e-79 a0^-1.
- Completes exact Fraction code, an independently reviewed enclosure composer, and a Fortran binary128 scalar cross-check with a create-only NCP runner. NCP needs only optional compile/environment adjustment/execution; no new physics campaign is needed for this theorem.

## Provenance and validation

Stacked on actual PR123 HEAD `7060b2390caa931a74b3a377150731b98c2431a9`, itself a descendant of PR121. Science tree `b22ac13ca38d5bdbf1aa96cecc74e04c7f9e2e02` matches the reviewed local tree exactly. Every changed path is newly added under `research/hh_phys72_20261020/`.

New checks: 14 final unit tests; 22 independent exact checks; 13 angular rational witnesses; 19 native contract checks; four manufactured fields (12 scalar quadratures); 48 Coulomb function point evaluations at 60 digits. Fortran compiled and executed here, with the initial environment failure and subsequent narrow contract fixes preserved. Floating diagnostics are not the exact certificate authority.

The completed 76 PHYS71 panels and 152 inherited profiles were not re-integrated. PHYS63 existence, PHYS69 D2 and PHYS71 completed status remain reused. Corrected D3 SHA `f75d082e1966dd61a326c37b6ff14e8f330e010341a59a88eb4ca8d4734e6173`; frozen NPZ SHA `f1bd3074950163960cc2011682d013af60f9b17c471bea72ecbc2ffb19e6855d`. No finite-L Gamma is substituted for infinite-j growth; a failed sufficient condition is not a no-go. VigilODE reflecting-grid results are mapped explicitly before any abstract residual-bound reuse.

## Review entry points and remaining scope

Start with `REPORT_KO.md`, `theory/THEOREM_AND_MODEL_MAP.md`, `verification/EXACT_BOUND_CERTIFICATE.json`, `verification/THIRD_AND_HIGHER_ENCLOSURE.json`, `LOOP_RECORD.md`, and `NEXT_DAG.json` in the new subtree. Actual publication and create-only source/recovery backup acknowledgements are recorded separately.

The result is the actual exterior weighted operator and remainder. A numerical full DeltaZ sum still needs the D1/D2 radii and any new displayed-sum rounding. Original driven xi, origin/incoming-adjoint matching, sigma(E) and k_HH(T) remain separate successors. HH_R10=OFF.

Problem and result

The inherited work certifies the all-angular D2(21,20), but the corresponding third Born coefficient was still open. This draft derives and certifies one D3(21,20), m=0 = Z'''(0)/6 over all angular modes and all real r >= 27:

D3 = (2.14300135468641834333042543662 + 1.71865149630238869433259719024 i) × 10^-71 a0^-1

The displayed-center absolute error is at most **7.121295358370 × 10^-79 a0^-1**, below the fixed pre-pilot goal 10^-78. HH_R10 remains OFF.

## Changes

- Derive the bilinear D3 representation and an exact infinite angular-tail sum; choose L=36, T=65 with a separately certified radial cutoff.
- Reuse all 152 inherited q payloads. Compute 76 accepted new panels; retain the separate goal-failed pilot, so the actual total is 77 physical panel calls.
- Contract through 73 angular moments and propagate Taylor coefficient uncertainty in the original orthonormal basis. This removes interval dependency inflation without discarding uncertainty.
- Add a strict runner, stdlib finalizer, and independent saved-evidence verifier. NCP delivery uses the finished implementation; no solver design is delegated.
- Preserve the original producer and rejected aggregate. Independent review found that the shortened radial decimal 1.484322e-79 rounded inward. A separate finalizer adopts the PR115 upward endpoint 1.48432231489e-79 from unchanged numerical payloads, with no panel replay.
- Add a D3-complete DAG child while preserving the combined higher-remainder node as PARTIAL_D3_COMPLETE_HIGHER_REMAINDER_OPEN.

## Validation

54 distinct new tests passed in separate recorded runs (not one combined suite). The corrected independent audit verifies 76 panel hashes, 5,624 carry checks, all 152 inherited payload hashes, the exact interval sum, independently recomputed angular and radial bounds, and printed-center rounding. The existing-result finalizer reuse performs zero physical panels and zero file writes.

Completed PHYS64–70 campaigns were not rerun. No NCP job was submitted; host state remains UNKNOWN. No CI result is claimed.

Problem and result

The original HH D2 client spends most of its work in general GMRES despite a block triangular full Jacobian. This PR derives and implements its exact O(L) shifted solve, retains the original nonautonomous Rodas5P equations, and adds ordered angular SIMD plus independent-job parallelism.

On the same sandbox host and binary, 18 new paired L28 work/precision runs give setup-plus-solve median improvements of 98.7113x and 91.1700x over the unchanged pinned PHYS69 GMRES path. The stored D2 values meet relative goals 3e-10 and 3e-12 against the unchanged finite-L28 certificate. Process-wall median ratios are separately 48.0449x and 71.6688x. These are measured scoped results, not generic VigilODE or NCP guarantees.

## Changes and validation

- Exact full shifted inverse, including both shared external-channel derivatives; denominator >=17171964889/18225000000 for L<=64,r>=27,h<=0.5.
- Reuse VigilODE a21d573980f66fe02891bd216153443b5352f921 Rodas5P raw-U coefficients and PI; pin wide1.7.1 and rayon1.12.0.
- Driver retained vector capacity 256280->30632 bytes; kernel tables/rows add52736 bytes separately. RSS is not claimed measured.
- 12 new independent-trajectory runs preserve state bits across1/2/4 workers; the single4-worker batch is2.01778x faster than1worker.
- 13 Rust tests pass. Wrapper initial19 pass;3 newly added guard tests and2 affected tests pass after preserving red evidence.35 distinct tests, no claim of a final single35-test suite.
- One new guarded sandbox runner pilot completes; read-only resume changes0files and launches0integrations. Optimized L64 has only cheap preflight evidence; no remote NCP submission.
- Independent algebra/code and exact point-error/performance reviews close the two concrete defects and verify original receipts without solver reruns.

PHYS68 certified the finite L28 second Born entry but left its excluded angular modes open. This PR derives an all-j Coulomb ratio bound and a summable angular tail, reuses the completed L28 result, and integrates only the new j29..36 band.

The actual all-angular/all-radial m0 DtN coefficient D2(21,20)=Z''(0)/2 at the original B27,k7/10,E49/200 is enclosed around (7.01774363281637372857673+3.20016322230539545153550i)e-48 a0^-1 with absolute error <=1.279825889920e-64 including displayed-center rounding. The original1e-62 goal is met.

## Implementation and evidence

- 76new validated band panels, each computed once; first2reused then74new. Prior PHYS68 integrals were not repeated.
- Exact Fraction combination of old numerical radius, new band radius, one PR115 radial tail and all j>36 angular tail.
- Pinned VigilODE a21d573980f66fe02891bd216153443b5352f921, num-complex0.4.6 and gauss-quad0.3.2 applied in a real Rust matrix-free RODAS5P client with analytic JVP/time partial.
- Two native L28 runs completed; stored-point relative-error upper bounds4.755593436e-11 and3.775319802e-13 against the reused Arb certificate.
- 137new Python and7Rust distinct tests pass. Preserved compile ENOSPC and two corrected test-fixture failures. Independent mathematics, band and final assembly reviews pass.

Read research/hh_phys69_20261019/REPORT_KO.md, NEXT_DAG.json, theory/PROOF.md, all_angular/CERTIFICATE.json and the handoffs. Result and need

PHYS67 certified a first-Born boundary entry. A validated second-Born coefficient needs the radial first-Born profiles and a controlled reciprocal of each intermediate Coulomb mode. This PR implements that calculation for the original screened Hamiltonian, m=0, L=28, external channels (21,20), with every intermediate j=0..28.

The exact stored D2 midpoint is approximately (7.017743632815532786 + 3.200163222305211742 i)e-48 a0^-1. Its complex absolute error is <8.691e-67 a0^-1, including numerical integration, Coulomb and exact angular evaluation, ball-arithmetic roundoff, and the separate PR115 radial cutoff. The displayed decimal is rounded; the certificate contains the authoritative exact dyadic midpoint.

## What changes

- Coulomb ODE Taylor recurrence, complex-disk majorants, positive zero-free reciprocal gates, and exact m0 Laurent angular preparation.
- 57 unique two-row D1 profiles on 76 panels covering B27..T65; all required D1(B) errors <8.764e-53.

- Bounded checkpoint fix for outward-rounded Arb serialization: preserve original payload bytes, verify raw predecessor chains and exact box inclusion. Two original panels reused and only 74 new panels computed.
- Complete optional L64 D2 runner with fixed request, source/runtime binding, locking, resume, timeout and memory limits. Fresh-restored standalone runner verifies 34 payloads and import/help/request binding.
- Independent standard-library Rust angular/RK4 calculation and exact comparisons with existing saved PHYS66/67 results.

PHYS71 completed the all-angular/all-radial third Born coefficient, while a quantitative bound on the actual outgoing Coulomb Green operator and the higher exterior Born remainder remained open. This additive cycle closes that fixed exterior obligation.

- Proves the actual Dirichlet outgoing inverse bound ||R0 f/r|| <= C_R ||r f||, C_R=(10+sqrt(1423))/189 < 253/1000, retaining the nonzero Coulomb boundary flux.
- Controls the original noncentral screen on radial/angular L2, H1 and the inherited growing-C_j spaces. The actual L2 sandwich norm is q=553311/10^26=5.53311e-21; the R0 V bounds on H1 and H_C are 2q and 77q.
- Establishes operator-norm convergence at lambda=1 and the (21,20),m0 order>=4 tail <1.50654e-80 a0^-1. Reusing the unchanged corrected PHYS71 D3 center encloses (Z1-Z0)-exactD1-exactD2 within 7.271949342749e-79 a0^-1.
- Completes exact Fraction code, an independently reviewed enclosure composer, and a Fortran binary128 scalar cross-check with a create-only NCP runner. NCP needs only optional compile/environment adjustment/execution; no new physics campaign is needed for this theorem.

Fortran compiled and executed here, with the initial environment failure and subsequent narrow contract fixes preserved. Floating diagnostics are not the exact certificate authority.

The completed 76 PHYS71 panels and 152 inherited profiles were not re-integrated. PHYS63 existence, PHYS69 D2 and PHYS71 completed status remain reused. No finite-L Gamma is substituted for infinite-j growth; a failed sufficient condition is not a no-go. VigilODE reflecting-grid results are mapped explicitly before any abstract residual-bound reuse.

The inherited work certifies the all-angular D2(21,20), but the corresponding third Born coefficient was still open. This draft derives and certifies one D3(21,20), m=0 = Z'''(0)/6 over all angular modes and all real r >= 27:

D3 = (2.14300135468641834333042543662 + 1.71865149630238869433259719024 i) × 10^-71 a0^-1

The displayed-center absolute error is at most **7.121295358370 × 10^-79 a0^-1**, below the fixed pre-pilot goal 10^-78. HH_R10 remains OFF.

## Changes

- Derive the bilinear D3 representation and an exact infinite angular-tail sum; choose L=36, T=65 with a separately certified radial cutoff.
- Reuse all 152 inherited q payloads. Compute 76 accepted new panels; retain the separate goal-failed pilot, so the actual total is 77 physical panel calls.
- Contract through 73 angular moments and propagate Taylor coefficient uncertainty in the original orthonormal basis. This removes interval dependency inflation without discarding uncertainty.
- Add a strict runner, stdlib finalizer, and independent saved-evidence verifier. NCP delivery uses the finished implementation; no solver design is delegated.
- Preserve the original producer and rejected aggregate. Independent review found that the shortened radial decimal 1.484322e-79 rounded inward. A separate finalizer adopts the PR115 upward endpoint 1.48432231489e-79 from unchanged numerical payloads, with no panel replay.
- Add a D3-complete DAG child while preserving the combined higher-remainder node as PARTIAL_D3_COMPLETE_HIGHER_REMAINDER_OPEN.

The corrected independent audit verifies 76 panel hashes, 5,624 carry checks, all 152 inherited payload hashes, the exact interval sum, independently recomputed angular and radial bounds, and printed-center rounding. Problem and result

The original HH D2 client spends most of its work in general GMRES despite a block triangular full Jacobian. This PR derives and implements its exact O(L) shifted solve, retains the original nonautonomous Rodas5P equations, and adds ordered angular SIMD plus independent-job parallelism.

On the same sandbox host and binary, 18 new paired L28 work/precision runs give setup-plus-solve median improvements of 98.7113x and 91.1700x over the unchanged pinned PHYS69 GMRES path. The stored D2 values meet relative goals 3e-10 and 3e-12 against the unchanged finite-L28 certificate. Process-wall median ratios are separately 48.0449x and 71.6688x. These are measured scoped results, not generic VigilODE or NCP guarantees.

## Changes and validation

- Exact full shifted inverse, including both shared external-channel derivatives; denominator >=17171964889/18225000000 for L<=64,r>=27,h<=0.5.
- Reuse VigilODE a21d573980f66fe02891bd216153443b5352f921 Rodas5P raw-U coefficients and PI; pin wide1.7.1 and rayon1.12.0.
- Driver retained vector capacity 256280->30632 bytes; kernel tables/rows add52736 bytes separately. RSS is not claimed measured.
- 12 new independent-trajectory runs preserve state bits across1/2/4 workers; the single4-worker batch is2.01778x faster than1worker.
- 13 Rust tests pass. Wrapper initial19 pass;3 newly added guard tests and2 affected tests pass after preserving red evidence.35 distinct tests, no claim of a final single35-test suite.
- One new guarded sandbox runner pilot completes; read-only resume changes0files and launches0integrations. Optimized L64 has only cheap preflight evidence; no remote NCP submission.
- Independent algebra/code and exact point-error/performance reviews close the two concrete defects and verify original receipts without solver reruns.

Result and need

PHYS67 certified a first-Born boundary entry. A validated second-Born coefficient needs the radial first-Born profiles and a controlled reciprocal of each intermediate Coulomb mode. This PR implements that calculation for the original screened Hamiltonian, m=0, L=28, external channels (21,20), with every intermediate j=0..28.

The exact stored D2 midpoint is approximately (7.017743632815532786 + 3.200163222305211742 i)e-48 a0^-1. Its complex absolute error is <8.691e-67 a0^-1, including numerical integration, Coulomb and exact angular evaluation, ball-arithmetic roundoff, and the separate PR115 radial cutoff. The displayed decimal is rounded; the certificate contains the authoritative exact dyadic midpoint.

## What changes

- Coulomb ODE Taylor recurrence, complex-disk majorants, positive zero-free reciprocal gates, and exact m0 Laurent angular preparation.
- 57 unique two-row D1 profiles on 76 panels covering B27..T65; all required D1(B) errors <8.764e-53.
- Full j-sum for the selected second-Born entry; no conjugate and no extra factor two.
- Bounded checkpoint fix for outward-rounded Arb serialization: preserve original payload bytes, verify raw predecessor chains and exact box inclusion. Two original panels reused and only 74 new panels computed.
- Complete optional L64 D2 runner with fixed request, source/runtime binding, locking, resume, timeout and memory limits. Fresh-restored standalone runner verifies 34 payloads and import/help/request binding.
- Independent standard-library Rust angular/RK4 calculation and exact comparisons with existing saved PHYS66/67 results.

## Actual verification and execution

128 distinct new Python tests plus 5 native Rust tests passed. The independent stored-data review used exact Fraction arithmetic without importing Arb or the project solver: 76 payload chains, 17,328 boundary inequalities, 2,204 positive zero-free gates, every intermediate-mode sum and final error budget passed.

Rust 1.94.1 actually compiled and ran 2432/4864 steps once each. The fine result has actual relative error <4.885e-10 against the certificate. The saved PHYS66 pilot D2 scalar has actual absolute error about 1.7486685e-59; the old pilot was not rerun. The new D1 enclosure is contained in the old PHYS67 enclosure.

No completed PHYS64 NCP20 campaign, PHYS66 pilot/smoke or historical PHYS67 suite was repeated. L64 mathematical preflight ran once; L64 radial panels and NCP submissions are zero. NCP host state remains unknown until actual host receipts are inspected.
